# Camel packages

Reusable Rust packages maintained in the Camel repository.

| Package | Purpose | Documentation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `camel-library-manager` | Discover, install, update, remove, and locate Camel source libraries. | [Package guide](camel-library-manager/README.md) |

The manager is a Rust host package. Installable `.camel` source libraries are listed separately in the [public library catalog](../libraries/README.md).
